summary: Phase 12 Multi-Integration Framework + Email Triggers - COMPREHENSIVE TESTING COMPLETED. All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend admin pages (Integrations + Email Outbox) verified working. Email triggers successfully tested across all flows (lead/project/approval/invoice). Mock email provider writing to outbox correctly. Secret masking and RBAC enforcement working as expected.

✅ RBAC: Admin-only endpoints correctly return 403 for staff/client

✅ GET /api/admin/integrations/email returns email config
✅ PUT /api/admin/integrations/email saves configuration
✅ Secret masking round-trip: sending ******** preserves existing password in DB
✅ POST /api/admin/integrations/email/test sends test email via mock provider
✅ GET /api/admin/integrations/email/outbox lists emails with pagination
✅ GET /api/admin/integrations/email/outbox/{id} returns email detail + events timeline
✅ GET /api/admin/integrations/email/templates lists 12 templates (6 template_ids × 2 locales: id/en)
✅ PUT /api/admin/integrations/email/templates/{id}/{locale} upserts template
✅ GET/PUT /api/admin/integrations/payment works (placeholder provider)
✅ GET/PUT /api/admin/integrations/storage works (placeholder provider)
✅ Email trigger: Lead created → emails sent to all admin+staff users (4 emails)

✅ Email trigger: Approval requested → emails sent to admin/staff
✅ Email trigger: Approval signed → emails sent to stakeholders
✅ Email trigger: Invoice created → email sent to client
✅ Email trigger: Invoice overdue → email sent to client
✅ Frontend: Admin login successful
✅ Frontend: /portal/admin/settings/integrations page loads

✅ Frontend: Mock provider shows MOCK badge with notice

✅ Frontend: /portal/admin/settings/email-outbox page loads with table
✅ Frontend: Email outbox displays 23 emails with template_id, provider, status columns
✅ Frontend: All email triggers visible in outbox (lead_created, project_created, approval_requested, invoice_created, invoice_overdue, admin_test_email)
✅ Frontend: Status filter ('Semua Status') and Refresh button ('Muat Ulang') present
✅ Frontend: Eye icon buttons for viewing email details present
✅ No hardcoded API keys in backend .env (user requirement satisfied)
